fields.manufacturer_info:

fields.intended_purpose: The CardioFlex Coronary Stent System is indicated for improving coronary luminal diameter in patients with symptomatic ischemic heart disease due to de novo native coronary artery lesions.
fields.device_description: Balloon-expandable cobalt-chromium (CoCr) coronary stent mounted on a rapid exchange delivery catheter system.
fields.warnings_precautions: Rx Only. Carefully inspect packaging for sterile barrier breach prior to opening. Do not use if temperature indicator is activated. Not evaluated for pediatric use.
fields.instructions_for_use:
Refer to complete Instructions for Use (Doc ID IFU-CF-002) for detailed preparation, balloon inflation pressure charts, and post-dilatation protocols. Questions: contact 1-800-555-0199.

[IFU Contact Update]: Inquiries and adverse event reports: 450 Enterprise Boulevard, Suite 500, Boston, MA 02110, USA
fields.storage_handling: Store at controlled room temperature 15°C to 25°C (59°F to 77°F). Excursions permitted up to 30°C. Protect from direct moisture and sunlight.
fields.sterilization_info: Sterilized using Ethylene Oxide gas (EO). Sterile barrier: Double Tyvek pouch. Do not resterilize.
fields.shelf_life_expiry: Shelf Life: 24 Months. Expiration date indicated on package label in YYYY-MM-DD format.
